name: Potion
description:
Restores a small amount of
Health.

Restores a moderate amount
of Health.

Increases the maximum
Health level slightly.

Medicine that increases 
the maximum Health level

traces of poison from your
system.

Medicine that enhances
natural recovery ability.

becoming fatigued for a
period of time.

Increases Defense

to stone-like armor.

Increases Defense

A pill that temporarily
makes your skin as hard as
metal.

temporary resistance

temporary resistance

A chemical agent that
melts away the frozen
tundra in the soul.

Temporarily activates
an ESP-like ability to
sense monsters.

Can be mixed with
insect stomach juices
to make an adhesive.

A broth made from only the
thickest of a monster's
juices. Quite rich.

Further distilled monster
broth, although I don't
recommend touching it...

Fluids of a Thunderbug.

an electrical discharge.

Gelatin from a Great
Thunderbug. More powerful
than Juice. Easier to use.

amount of Health.

a full recovery.

Restores Health and
Stamina to maximum levels,

Recovers Stamina and cures
fatigue. Approved by the
Guild.

A dangerous chemical
that explodes when
disturbed or heated.

Mysterious crystals
long worshipped as a
fount of life.

Medicine created by
combining Lifecrystals.
Strong restorative power.

Amulet that raises Attack
power. The holder gains
the strength of a demon.

Amulet that raises
Attack. Made from a
Lao-Shan's Claw.

description:
Amulet that causes one's
skin to become as hard as
stone. Raises Defense.

name: Armortalon

Amulet that raises

Lao-Shan's Claw.

Medicine that is used
as an anesthetic when
combined.

Meat obtained through
carving up a monster.

Poisons if consumed.
Used as bait in traps.

Paralyzes if consumed.
Used as bait in traps.

Causes sleepiness if
consumed. Used as
bait in traps.

Meat cooked on the
rare side. Gives a small
boost to Stamina.

Well-cooked meat.

to Stamina.

perfection. Gives a full
boost to Stamina.

Meat burnt to a crisp.

but can also weaken you.

recover a bit of Stamina.

Eat to cool the body, ward

recover a bit of Stamina.

A lightly brazed fish.

Health Gauge when eaten.

Recover the red portion of
the Health gauge and
increase natural recovery.

Recovers red portion of
the Health gauge and
increases resilience.

name: Burnt Fish
description:
A fish burnt to a crisp.
Sometimes recovers Health,
but can also harm you...

description:
Returns when thrown. A
peculiar shaped weapon
from a foreign land.

description:
A standard throwing knife.
Goes straight to a target.
~C05(Supply Item)

Throwing knife with a
poison edge. Has a toxic
effect. ~C05(Supply Item)

powder. ~C05(Supply Item)

Throwing knife with a
paralysis toxin coated

A knife made to assist in

strikes. ~C05(Supply Item)

Basic ingredient for
making hand-thrown bombs.

Can be thrown at a
monster to mark it
for easy tracking.

Bomb that flashes
brightly upon impact.
Blinds monsters.

high-frequency sound
upon detonation.

Monster excrement. One

fertility of a row.

Wyvern excrement. One

fertility of all rows.

Creates a terrible smell

wyverns dislike.

smoke in the area where
it lands.

Smoke bomb containing a
toxic chemical. Popular as
a household bug bomb.

description:
Instantly transports
you back to base camp.

Removes item usage blocks.
When thrown on the ground,
its smoke deodorizes.

description:
Use to subdue and capture
a trapped monster.

description:
A spider's web.
Very sticky.

Powerful net able to
withstand a certain 
amount of weight.

various types of traps,

capturing.

Will attract lightning
after a while. Can be
used in the rain.

drawing on it.

Upgraded Small Barrel

lightly despite its size.

Powerful bomb triggered

impact.

Upgraded Large Barrel
Bomb. Effective against
large monsters.

set. This modified bomb
requires skill to use.

Improved version of the
Bounce Bomb. Requires
some skill to use.

Small time bomb that
attaches to an enemy.

novices, but don't expect
much. Unlimited shots.

powerful than Normal S
Lv1. Maximum of 99 shots.

Tremendously powerful and

and explodes. Max 9 shots.

fire. Max 3 shots.

fire. Max 3 shots.

fire. Max 3 shots.

Stronger paralysis effect,

combining.

paralysis effect.

many different purposes.

the eye. ~C05(Account Item)

insect an artisan.

name: King Scarab
description:
The royal class of the
scarabs, with a hard shell
and lustrous wings.

name: Emperor Cricket
description:
Exceptionally strong shell
makes it a good counter-
part to soft materials.

name: Killer Beetle
description:
Insect with a hard shell 
and dazzling wings. Used
as an abrasive.

name: Hercudrome
description:
Said to be the world's
strongest bug. Widely used
in making equipment.

name: Rare Scarab
description:
A rare, prized insect.
Used to increase the power
of metal objects.

name: PhantomButterfly
description:
Rarely seen by humans,
its wings shimmer like
precious gems.

name: Royal Rhino
description:
Beetle with a jewel-like
shine and prized by
collectors. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Divine Rhino
description:
Beetle that glows as if
from the heavens. Loved by
collectors. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Rainbow Insect
description:
Beautiful insect material.
Colors and properties
depend on many variables.

name: Great Hornfly
description:
Insect with a giant horn,
massive shell, and wings
of butterfly-like beauty.

name: Great Ladybug
description:
Giant insect with a very
hard shell. Protects crops
by eating harmful pests.

name: Screamer
description:
A monster's internal
organ. If broken, it
emits a shrill sound.

name: Poison Sac
description:
A monster's internal
organ. Contains a 
lethal poison.

name: Toxin Sac
description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with potent toxin. 
Dangerous, even to touch.

name: DeadlyPoisonSac
description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a most lethal
toxin. Use extreme care.

name: Paralysis Sac
description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a paralyzing
neurotoxin.

name: Sleep Sac
description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a powder that
causes sleep when inhaled.

name: Coma Sac
description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a powder that
can induce a coma.

name: Flame Sac
description:
A monster's internal
organ. Contains a very
flammable powder.

name: Inferno Sac
description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a powder that
ignites when touched.

name: Blazing Fire Sac
description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with an explosive
powder. Watch out!

name: Electro Sac
description:
The internal organ of a
Khezu. Releases
electricity if disturbed.

name: Thunder Sac
description:
The internal organ of a
Khezu. Contains unequaled
electrical energy.

name: Lightning Sac
description:
A monster's internal organ
charged with electricity &
the rumbling of thunder.

name: Power Extract
description:
Gypceros extract. The
secret to its ability to
run fast and far.

name: Pale Extract
description:
Khezu extract. Has the
ability to amplify the
effects of medicines.

name: Sm Monster Bone
description:
A very useful material,
indispensable for both
hunting and daily life.

name: Med Monster Bone
description:
Has more uses than
small bone. Usually
carved to make an item.

name: Lg Monster Bone
description:
Indispensable for crafting
one-piece items. Bone can 
be connected to shell.

name: Monster Bone+
description:
Top quality monster bone.
Hard to find but a nearly
unbreakable material.

name: Hrd Monster Bone
description:
A monster's most unique
bone. Priceless strength,
but difficult to work.

name: Hvy Monster Bone
description:
Strong bone from only the
toughest of wyverns. It's
very thick and heavy.

name: Eldr Dragon Bone
description:
You can sense the elder
dragon's dignity from this
massive bone alone.

name: BigEDragonBone
description:
Top-notch bone from a
large dragon. Feels like
it could last forever.

name: Mystery Bone
description:
A well-worn bone.
Not sturdy enough
to use in combination.

name: Unknown Skull
description:
Animal skull. So worn
and weathered, it's
unidentifiable.

name: Master's Skull
description:
The remains of a top
hunter who once let his
guard down.

name: Bone
description:
Just a bone. So worn
and weathered, it's
unidentifiable.

name: RobustWyvernBone
description:
A bird wyvern's robust
bone. It's easy to work
with and is very durable.

name: Brute Bone
description:
The stout bone of a
brutish monster. An easy
to work material.

name: Giant Bone
description:
A fat, large bone. Can be
cut in the workshop to
make crafting material.

name: Stout Bone
description:
The stout, hard bone of a
brute. Rigid, it is
priceless for crafting.

name: Massive Bone
description:
Very hard bone from a very
large beast. Its worth as
material is beyond words.

name: Wyvern Fang
description:
Used for Bowgun munitions.
Combined with explosives,
it makes spreading shots.

name: Wyvern Claw
description:
Used for Bowgun munitions.
Combined with explosives,
it makes explosive shots.

name: Wyvern Stone
description:
A unique item formed by
the hardening of foreign
materials inside a wyvern.

name: Big Wyvern Stone
description:
A Wyvern Stone that's had
years upon years to form.
It has a mysterious glow.

name: BigEDragonJewel
description:
Ultra-rarely does a giant
stone like this form
inside an Elder Dragon.

name: White Liver
description:
A white liver, just as
stated. Its texture is
adored. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Popo Tongue
description:
A Popo tongue is popular,
healthy, and enjoyable to
eat. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Secret Pouch
description:
The pouch carried by a
Melynx. The insides are a
jumble. ~C05(Account Item)

name: CarapaceonBrains
description:
The brain matter of a
Carapaceon. A widely known
delicacy. ~C05(Account Item)

name: CarapaceonBrain+
description:
First-class Carapaceon
Brains. An Einsteinian
delicacy. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Piscine Liver
description:
Internal organ from a
Piscine Wyvern. A great
cure-all. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Wyvern Tears
description:
Precious tears wept only
on special occasions.
~C05(Account Item)

name: Wyvern Sobs
description:
Precious crocodile tears
wept only on special
occasions. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Territorial Dung
description:
Droppings used by a
monster to mark territory.
~C05(Account Item)

name: TerritorialDung+
description:
Large droppings used by a
monster to mark territory.
~C05(Account Item)

name: Crab Pearl
description:
A jewel polished by time
inside a monster's body.
~C05(Account Item)

name: Crab Pearl+
description:
A treasured jewel polished
by time inside a monster's
body. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Dragon Treasure
description:
Shining stones gathered
and loved by an elder
dragon. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Anc Drgn Treasre
description:
This stone's radiance 
grows brighter as time
passes.~C05(Account Item)

name: Decayed Drgn Scl
description:
Decays as time
relentlessly attacks its
surface. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Dragon Herb
description:
Crystallized Dragon Scale.
Priceless as a natural
medicine. ~C05(Account Item)

name: Felyne Fur Ruby
description:
Priceless ruby formed by
the rare hardening of a
Felyne hairball.

name: Mosswine Hide
description:
Mosswine hide.
It's covered in moss.

name: Bullfango Pelt
description:
Bullfango hide. It's
covered in bristly fur.

name: ThkBullfangoPelt
description:
High-grade Bullfango Pelt.
The fur is thick and of
superior quality.

name: Bullfango Head
description:
A Bullfango head with
a pair of huge fangs.

name: Bulldrome Tusk
description:
Majestic Bulldrome Tusk.
The damaged surface tells
the tale of many battles.

name: Bulldrome Hide
description:
A Bulldrome's bristly
hide. It is strangely
beautiful.

name: Bulldrome Hide+
description:
The tough hide of a
Bulldrome. It is
unblemished.

name: Kelbi Horn
description:
Infusions of powdered
Kelbi Horn are used
as medicine.

name: Kelbi Hide
description:
Used to join the plates
in a suit of armor and
to make winter clothing.

name: Anteka Antlers
description:
The horns of an Anteka.
Used in weapons, armor,
and interior decorating.

name: Anteka Pelt
description:
The soft, thick fur of an
Anteka. Provides 
protection from cold.

name: High Qualty Pelt
description:
Feels excellent to the
touch. Difficult to carve
but valued by the Guild.

name: Remobra Skin
description:
The black skin of a wyvern
called a Remobra. Its
glossy surface sheens.

name: Remobra Skin+
description:
A high quality Remobra
skin. It has a vivid black
luster.

name: SpecRemobraSkin+
description:
Superior quality Remobra
skin. Its shines with a
Black Pearl-like luster.

name: Striped Skin
description:
The striped skin of a
Remobra. The black and red
stripes are very popular.

name: Remobra Skull
description:
Skull of a serpent-like
Remobra. Even in death its
fangs appear powerful.

name: ShakalakaTreasre
description:
Dropped by a Shakalaka in
a state of confusion.
Looks like trash...

name: ShakalakaTreasr+
description:
The rarest of the rare
things Shakalakas' drop,
their prized... garbage!?

name: ShakaInheritance
description:
Dropped by King Shakalaka.
It's the King's
splendid... garbage?

name: Giaprey Scale
description:
The color of this scale
allows you to approach in
the snow unseen.

name: Giaprey Scale+
description:
Scale ripped from a
Giaprey. Used to craft
excellent equipment.

name: Giaprey Hide
description:
Hide stripped of its
scales. Used to make
clothing for villagers.

name: Giaprey Hide+
description:
High quality Giaprey Hide.
A pathway to the creation
of sturdy equipment.

name: Giadrome Hide
description:
The hide of a Giadrome. It
bears the scars of a
leader's battles.

name: Giadrome Claw
description:
Sharper than a Giaprey 
claw, touching it bare-
handed is quite dangerous.

name: Giadrome Claw+
description:
A sharp Giadrome Claw. The
deadly weapon of a
Giadrome pack leader.

name: Giadrome Skull
description:
The large crest on this
Giadrome skull denotes 
it as a pack leader.

name: Velociprey Fang
description:
Sharp (though not as
sharp as a wyvern fang).
Used to make Bowgun ammo.

name: Velociprey Scale
description:
Scale obtained by carving
up a Velociprey.
Blue and black in color.

name: Velociprey Scle+
description:
Scale stripped from a
Velociprey. It can be made
into light, durable armor.

name: Velociprey Hide
description:
Hide stripped of its
scales. Used to join the
plates in a suit of armor.

name: Velociprey Hide+
description:
The high quality, descaled
hide of a Velociprey, it
has many applications.

name: Velocidrome Hide
description:
The hide of a Velociprey
leader. It bears the scars
of a leadership role.

name: Velocidrome Claw
description:
Claw from an alpha
Velociprey. Sharp and
blade-like.

name: Velocidrome Clw+
description:
The sharp claw of a
Velocidrome. It can easily
slice through prey.

name: Velocidrome Head
description:
Large head with a crest.
You'd look pretty fierce
if you put it on.

name: Genprey Fang
description:
Poisonous fang from a
Genprey. Paralyzing toxin
even works on wyverns.

name: Genprey Scale
description:
Scale from a Genprey.
Acts as camouflage in the
desert zone.

name: Genprey Scale+
description:
Scale taken from a
Genprey. Strong enough to
repel a wyvern's fangs.

name: Genprey Hide
description:
A hide with all the scales
removed. Can be tanned at
the fort.

name: Genprey Hide+
description:
The high quality, descaled
hide of a Genprey, it can
neutralize neurotoxins.

name: Gendrome Hide
description:
Sturdy green hide from
a Gendrome. Perfect for
making strong armor.

name: Gendrome Tail
description:
This flexible tail has
adapted to the harsh
conditions of the desert.

name: Gendrome Skull
description:
The skull of a Gendrome is
noted for its two crests.

name: Ioprey Fang
description:
Fang filled with deadly
poison. Care is required
when handling it.

name: Ioprey Scale
description:
The dangerous poison
normally in the scale
has been removed.

name: Ioprey Scale+
description:
Scale stripped from an
Ioprey. Can be used, once
the poison is removed.

name: Ioprey Hide
description:
Descaled hide, often made
into belts. Red belts are
used in decorations.

name: Ioprey Hide+
description:
High quality, descaled
hide of an Ioprey, the
red skin resists poison.

name: Iodrome Hide
description:
Sturdy red hide from
an Iodrome. Perfect for
making strong armor.

name: Iodrome Skull
description:
The large crest on an
Iodrome's skull is enough
to catch the eyes of all.

name: OrangeHypnoPelt
description:
Vibrant orange pelt of a
Hypnocatrice. It's great
for making strong leather.

name: OrangeHypnoPelt+
description:
Thick and vibrant orange
fur. It's a very valuable
crafting material.

name: Top-GrdHypnoClaw
description:
Very sharp and rigid high-
quality claw. The shine is
proof of its quality.

name: Hypno Claw+
description:
Hypnocatrice's hard claw.
One kick with this on,
and your prey is done.

name: Hypno Bezoar
description:
Helps the Hypnocatrice
digest its food. It's
transparent, yet shines.

name: Hypno Bezoar+
description:
Noblewomen's desire, this
stone is very pure and
has a beautiful shape.

name: Hypno Beak
description:
Complex-shaped beak. Its
unique shape is popular
in some hunting circles.

name: Hypno Fang
description:
This beak looks like a
fang. Its hardness is
good for combining.

name: RainbowTailFeath
description:
Light-refracting tail
feather. Used in jewelry,
young women love this.

name: Hypno Ticket
description:
Stamped proof of hunting a
Hypnocatrice and finishing
a hard quest.

name: Kut-Ku Scale
description:
Pink colored scale from a
Kut-Ku. Fire-resistant.
Can be found in the field.

name: Kut-Ku Scale+
description:
Superior scale from a Kut-
Ku. Its size and weight
are a cut above.

name: Thick Kut-Ku Scl
description:
The pinnacle of Kut-Ku
scales. Very few scales
mature to this degree.

name: Kut-Ku Shell
description:
The Fire resistant shell
of a Kut-Ku. Quite
resistant to Fire.

name: Kut-Ku Carapace
description:
Harder than Kut-Ku Shell,
this material is also 
known as Gravite.

name: Hvy Kut-Ku Shell
description:
Stout outer shell, harder
than a Kut-Ku Carapace.
Also known as Mediastinum.

name: Kut-Ku Ear
description:
The Fire resistant ear of
a Kut-Ku. Used to prevent
Bowgun flash-back.

name: Long Kut-Ku Ear
description:
Kut-Ku's Fire resistant
ear. The flexible material
is a good base for armor.

name: Lucky Kut-Ku Ear
description:
Highly-specialized ear.
Lots of flesh and good
texture makes it "lucky".

name: Giant Beak
description:
The huge, sturdy beak
of a Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Splendid Beak
description:
Finding a large, beautiful
beak in this shape is
quite rare! Splendid!

name: Kut-Ku Webbing
description:
Webbing from a Kut-Ku
wing. Better as a fusing
material than animal skin.

name: Str Kut-Ku Wing
description:
Top-grade Kut-Ku wing.
Stout, expansive, and
fire resistant material.

name: Blue Kut-Ku Scl
description:
Scale of the extremely
rare Blue Kut-Ku. Makes
vivid blue armor.

name: Blue Kut-Ku Scl+
description:
Superior scale from a Blue
Yian Kut-Ku. Its complex
color is infinitely cool.

name: ThkBlueKut-KuScl
description:
Super thick Blue Kut-Ku
scale. As blue as the
ocean, it's a work of art.

name: Blue Kut-Ku Shl
description:
Shell of a rare Blue
Kut-Ku. The vivid blue
makes it a popular item.

name: Blue Kut-Ku Cpc
description:
Rare Blue Kut-Ku Carapace.
Harder than its shell,
often used in crafting.

name: HvyBlueKut-KuShl
description:
Outer shell even thicker
than Blue Kut-Ku Cpc.
Crafters long for this.

name: Rubbery Hide
description:
Highly elastic Gypceros
hide. A good insulator,
resistant to electricity.

name: Rubbery Hide+
description:
High quality, highly
elastic Gypceros hide.
Gives off a strange scent.

name: SpecRubberyHide+
description:
Special quality, highly
elastic Gypceros hide.
Absorbs all attacks.

name: Gypceros Head
description:
The uniquely shaped head
of a Gypceros. A must have
for Gypceros lovers!

name: HardGypcerosHead
description:
Hard rubber-like head of
a Gyperos. A must for
all Gypceros lovers!

name: Pur Rubbery Hide
description:
A rarely seen Purple
Gypceros hide. The chic
purple hide is en vogue.

name: Pur Gypceros Wng
description:
A seldom seen purple wing
from a Gypceros.
Incredibly valuable.

name: HrdPuGypcerosWng
description:
Top-grade purple Gypceros
wing. Poison-resistant, it
makes for good protection.

name: Garuga Scale
description:
Scale carved from Yian
Garuga. It shines an
ominous purple.

name: Garuga Scale+
description:
Superior Garuga scale.
Looks like a Kut-Ku scale,
but it's much tougher.

name: ThickGarugaScale
description:
Top-grade Garuga scale.
Sparkles like purple
quartz and just as hard.

name: Garuga Shell
description:
A rare material admired
and the subject of much
research.

name: Garuga Carapace
description:
Garuga Shell that's become
stronger with time. Great
skill is needed to work.

name: Hvy Garuga Shell
description:
Heavy, dark purple outer
shell with an unusually
intimidating air about it.

name: Garuga Ear
description:
Its shape and form shows a
different evolutionary
path than Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Long Garuga Ear
description:
Well-developed Garuga Ear.
Worn as armor, it's said
to heighten one's senses.

name: Sharpened Beak
description:
The sharpened beak of Yian
Garuga. Compared to a Kut-
Ku, it's much deadlier.

name: Rejuvenated Beak
description:
Garuga beak. Its color,
luster, and the jawline's
angle have been restored.

name: Garuga Wing
description:
A first class material
that requires high
crafting technology.

name: Str Garuga Wing
description:
Large and well-developed
Garuga Wing. Prized among
crafters.

name: Garuga Tail
description:
Has a special function
that responds to shocks
with a powerful venom.

name: LethrGarugaTail
description:
Leathery tail outfitted
with deadly poison meant
to kill its target.

name: Garuga Mane
description:
A sense of coercion fills
the air. This mane is no
simple decoration.

name: SilverGarugaPelt
description:
Shimmering silver pelt
that mesmerizes with its
beauty when it flutters.

name: Blango Pelt
description:
Snow white Blango Pelt. It
protects the body against
the mountain cold.

name: Blango Pelt+
description:
Harder to work than normal
Blango Pelt, this has high
value as a material.

name: Sharp Claw
description:
A shining black claw.
Unlike wyvern claws, this
is shaped to grip objects.

name: Piercing Claw
description:
Dangerous to touch with
bare hands, it's used as
a knife in some workshops.

name: Blangonga Fang
description:
The fang of the killer
Blangonga. As sharp and
deadly as a dagger.

name: Blangonga Fang+
description:
A Blangonga bicuspid. As
large as a human thigh, it
has potential as a weapon.

name: HvyBlangongaFang
description:
Giant Blangonga Fang. Can
make shish kabobs out of
even medium-sized beasts.

name: Blangonga Pelt
description:
White fur with astounding
thermal properties and as
strong as an iron chain.

name: Blangonga Pelt+
description:
The hardened pelt of a
Blangonga. The needle-like
hairs are prized material.

name: HrdBlangongaPlt+
description:
Very hard Blangonga pelt.
Made tough by the arctic
winds. 100% natural armor.

name: Blangonga Whiskr
description:
Large whiskers on the head
denote the alpha leader
of a group of Blangos.

name: Lthr Pelagus Plt
description:
Especially tough Pelagus
pelt. You can tell its
owner was an aged leader.

name: Blangonga Tail
description:
The smooth feeling of a
Blangonga Tail is
undeniably appealing.

name: LeathrBlangoTail
description:
Leathery Blangonga tail.
Soft-as-snow fur makes it
prized crafting material.

name: C.BlangongaPelt+
description:
Copper Blangonga pelt.
It's harder due to the
harsh desert environment.

name: HvyC.BlangoFang
description:
Extremely sharp, big fang
infused with the strength
of desert survival.

name: LthrC.BlangoTail
description:
Leathery tail of a rich
copper color and as hard
as a boulder.

name: Conga Pelt
description:
Conga fur. Its solid feel
makes it a good material.

name: Conga Pelt+
description:
The hard pelt of a Conga.
The thick fur makes
long-lasting equipment.

name: Congalala Pelt
description:
Pink fur of a Congalala.
The tufts of hair are
often used in clothing.

name: Congalala Pelt+
description:
The stout hairs of this
pelt are important tools
in crafting equipment.

name: HrdCongalalaPlt+
description:
The even stouter hairs of
this pelt and its glossy
coat make it perfect.

name: Vibrant Pelt
description:
Vibrant hair that grows on
the head of a Congalala.
The colors are lovely.

name: Congalala Claw
description:
A Congalala Claw. Large
and sharp, it has a black
luster.

name: Congalala Claw+
description:
A long, hard, sharp claw
with a wild nature that
makes crafting difficult.

name: HrdCongalalaClw+
description:
Specially developed for
fighting. It's so sharp,
it's a natural weapon.

name: Congalala Fang
description:
The fang of a Congalala is
solid enough to crunch
objects into dust.

name: Lg Pelagus Fang
description:
Large Pelagus fang that
can bite through even the
hardest of boulders.

name: E.CongalalaPelt+
description:
Emerald fur, but the color
difference isn't all. It 
boasts better quality too.

name: HrdE.CongaClaw
description:
Emerald Congalala claw.
So hard it could pulverize
a giant tree to dust.

name: Vibrant Comb
description:
An Emerald Congalala's
comb. Proof of a leader.
Splendid and vivid color.

name: Rajang Horn
description:
Majestic gold horn of a
Rajang. Hunters yearn for
the heroism it represents.

name: Hard Rajang Horn
description:
Majestic large gold horn.
All who see it feel the
bravery of the hunter.

name: Rajang Fang
description:
This sharpened fang can
cut through anything dumb
enough to touch it.

name: Hvy Rajang Fang
description:
Fang that can cut through
anything. Once caught, the
prey's life vanishes.

name: Blk Rajang Pelt
description:
Black Rajang fur. When
crafted, the fabric is
desired even by royalty.

name: Blk Rajang Pelt+
description:
When made into armor, this
strong and leathery pelt
gives a sense of security.

name: Rajang Claw
description:
A sharp Rajang Claw.
Difficult to carve and
more difficult to craft.

name: Hard Rajang Claw
description:
A hard Rajang claw that
has taken many lives in a
most brutal fashion.

name: Rajang Tail
description:
The glistening tail of a
Rajang. The gold fur is
beautiful and elegant.

name: dummy
description: dummy

name: Gold Rajang Pelt
description:
The fur of a Rajang's
body. The gold hair is
treasured by tailors.

name: GoldRajangPelt+
description:
Shimmering golden pelt.
It shines with the furious
power of a Rajang's anger.

name: Piscine Fang
description:
Fang from a Plesioth
or Cephalos. Used
to hold and kill prey.

name: HvyPiscineFang
description:
Heavy Piscine fang that
can bite through even
large shelled creatures.

name: Plesioth Scale
description:
An incandescent scale
from a Plesioth. Becomes
brittle if it dries out.

name: Plesioth Scale+
description:
A faintly shining scale
from a Plesioth. It keeps
shining even when dry.

name: ThckPlesiothScl
description:
Brilliant Plesioth scale.
So thick that neither fang
nor claw can penetrate.

name: Plesioth Fin
description:
A beautiful fin from a
Plesioth. The spikes
are stunningly poisonous.

name: Plesioth Fin+
description:
Beautiful, high quality
fin. Its thorns are filled
with a strong neurotoxin.

name: SpecPlesiothFin+
description:
Top-quality material, and
the most beautiful of
Plesioth fins available.

name: Grn Plesioth Scl
